design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used average plausible values, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not apply sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not provide information indicating that it used multilevel modeling or accounted for school clustering in its analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.

design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): The study uses PISA 2018 data from 37 OECD countries and applies a Random Forest model with Boruta feature selection… to identify influential predictors… They provide coefficient estimates… but do not report standard predictive performance metrics…
